name: mashumaro-incremental-multi-value-1fd0
instr:
mashumaro cannot incrementally serialize bounded streams of multiple values. Add equivalent streams to dataclass mixins and typed codecs, preserving native framing and existing single-value behavior.

Each completed transport value produces one ordered `StreamItem` with its zero-based input index and either its value or failure. `StreamItem` is a Generic and is frozen. `StreamStateError` is a RuntimeError. `IncompleteStreamError` is a ValueError with `index`. `PendingDataLimitError` is a ValueError with `limit` and `pending_bytes`.

Decoders accept `feed` until `finish` or `cancel` and remain terminal afterward. Report incomplete terminal input once. `StreamOptions` is frozen; `StreamOptions.max_pending_bytes` bounds retained unfinished input without losing completed outcomes. Invalid terminal operations raise `StreamStateError`.

JSON and ORJSON parse top-level arrays across arbitrary text, byte, token, UTF-8, and nested-value boundaries. Malformed syntax terminates at its responsible index; ORJSON preserves caller options. YAML uses genuine document boundaries without treating scalar content as separators. MessagePack separates concatenated objects incrementally and retains incomplete tails. TOML frames exact document bytes with an unsigned decimal UTF-8 byte length and colon.

Every typed stream preserves its declared shape, dialect precedence, transport framing, and complete-value custom hook contract. Existing pre- and post-serialization hooks run once per completed item
